convert_dict_to_structure: convert a dictionary or CIF string to a pymatgen Structure object using to_structure
extract_composition_dict: extract the composition dictionary from a pymatgen Structure or dict using get_composition_dict
get_chemsys_from_composition: get the chemical system element set from a Composition or dict using get_chemsys
batch_torch_geometric_to_structures: convert batched PyTorch Geometric tensors to a list of pymatgen Structure objects using torch_geometric_to_structures
generate_structure_from_diffcsp: convert a diffcsp generation dict to a pymatgen Structure for a given index using diffcsp_to_structure
